lines.en: I walk on all fours.
My huge paws land softly.
I stride across the plains.
The fur on my shoulders bobs.
I walk through waist-high grass.
I walk with a saddle on my back.
My shadow is short and broad.
My four paws press through the grass.
My claws rustle the dry grass.
My head turns slowly.
Paws fall slow, ears keep turning
I brush past a bush.
I pause, then continue.
I sniff the prairie wind.
I sit here.
The prairie wind is fine.
I am licking my paw.
No one is in the saddle.
I smell other beasts.
I am heavy, but quiet.

lines.zh: 云影挪过草原，我跟着挪
lines.en: The cloud shadow crosses the plain and I follow it
I am sharpening my claws.
I patrol this prairie.
I am in no hurry.
My fur is thick.
I let out a slow breath.
A sound in the grass.
A grass seed in my ear, and it itches
Your shoulder only reaches my chest.
My paw is bigger than your head.
The saddle is empty, dare you take the stirrup
The saddle is empty.
The fear in your sweat smells sharper than the sweat
Do not touch my nose.
Are you not afraid of me?
Is your bow long enough?
I am watching your legs.
Standing, I would be taller than you.
Step back a pace to talk.
This scent is familiar.
If you want to ride, tighten the girth first.
I do not like my ears pulled.
Come closer and I will stand up.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我自己会判断
lines.en: Stand still, I will do the judging
You cut into my thick fur.
I dropped low and pulled back.
Guarding my ribs, I shift half a paw
A rumble came from my throat.

lines.zh: 厚毛挡了些，血还是淌下来
lines.en: The thick fur took some, but blood still runs
I sink my body into the grass.
My paws have not left the ground.

lines.zh: 你出手的时机比我算得准
lines.en: Your timing beats my reckoning
The girth came loose.
I have kept that scent.

lines.zh: 你袋子里漏出的味，骗不了我
lines.en: The smell leaking from your bag does not fool me
The wind carries a smell.
That is not enough in your hand.
Held that high, it is a strain to reach
I pad over.
Hold it steady.

lines.zh: 这么点，连牙缝都填不满
lines.en: That much will not even fill the gaps in my teeth
Thick and bloody, just my kind of meal

lines.zh: 拿着肉的手，别抖成筛子
lines.en: The hand holding meat should not shake like a sieve

lines.zh: 我坐着等，肉自己会到手
lines.en: I sit and wait, the meat comes to me
A little closer.
I am starting.
You hit my chest.
My claws grip the turf.
My paws are heavy.
You are squeezed aside.
The girth straps shifted.
You stepped on my paw.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，鞍带擦过你
lines.en: I give half a step and my girth brushes you

lines.zh: 这个重量不是你能推的
lines.en: This weight is not for you to push.
We flattened the grass.
Push me once more.
I am a Digimon too.
The saddle has nothing to do with it.
This body of mine is unsuited.
Stand farther off.
My claws could hurt you.
No one else on the prairie.
I do not understand these things.
It will be over soon.
I will remember you.

lines.zh: 这季节过去，我就当没见过你
lines.en: When the season ends, I will forget we met
I hold it under my palm.
This meat is not enough.
I chew it up in a few bites.
It is quite heavy.
What falls on the prairie is mine.
I carry it to the saddlebag.
Tastes good.
Back off, this is mine.
I will save it.
Hold still for now.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枯枝替我报了信
lines.en: The twig you snapped gave you away

lines.zh: 前掌离地，我比灌木还高
lines.en: Forepaws off the ground, I tower over the brush
I have watched you a while.
You are at the grass edge.
There is no rock to hide behind.
My throat drops low and the grass goes still
My paw is raised.
A gully to your left, me to your right
I smell your fear.
I close in slowly.
Four legs against two, do the math
Running will not help.

lines.zh: 我压着草浪，一尺一尺靠
lines.en: I push through the grass, a foot at a time
The grass will not hide you.

lines.zh: 你听见草被压的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the grass being pressed?
The rhythm in the grass broke.
I stop a few steps away.
One more step and you are within my leap
You run up the slope.
The grass is shorter up there.
I trail you until your legs give first
The girth straps are ringing.

lines.zh: 每一步都带出一声闷哼
lines.en: Every stride drags a low grunt out of me

lines.zh: 你的喘息已经乱了节拍
lines.en: Your breathing has lost its rhythm

lines.zh: 掌心的草皮被一起揭起
lines.en: Turf comes up along with the blow
You are smacked into the grass.

lines.zh: 侧过身，用整块肩顶出去
lines.en: I turn and drive my whole shoulder out
That paw came down solidly.

lines.zh: 牙关一合，锁在你锁骨上
lines.en: My jaws close and lock on your collarbone
My weight presses you flat to the soil
The girth strap caught you too.
The blow knocked it from your hand.
Another swipe.

lines.zh: 被我的掌按过，你还想爬
lines.en: Pinned by my paw, and you still want to rise
A pit of flattened grass.
Where else will you retreat?
In waist-high grass I lift my back
A wild one of me lands in the grass.
The saddle is still on my back.
The grass bent when I landed.
The wind is favorable here.
I sniff around.
Two of us came out.
This prairie can feed me.
I tuck my claws into the grass.
I have not been on this prairie.
I glance at the sun.
No one in the grass.
I move forward at an easy pace.
My girth is not tight yet.
Fire singed a patch of my fur.

lines.zh: 坡太陡，我滚了半圈才停
lines.en: The bank was steep, I rolled half a turn
The water makes my fur heavy.
Grass flew everywhere.
The shaft still quivers, buried in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那道光让我的数据乱跳
lines.en: That light makes my data jump.
Nothing to eat on the prairie.

lines.zh: 雷打在草原上，草都着了
lines.en: Lightning set the grass alight.
Even the grass is gone.
